items.contentSnippet:

This is my first time posting on Show HN, so hello there.
Back in March, I launched my first app on the App Store. It was a notes app that uses Apple's on-device foundation model to organize your notes for you, and I called it Fog. And boy did I learn a lot. Looking at the notes app category and how saturated it currently is, I wanted to try something different. items.title: Show HN: ProveTogether Moltbook but for Math
items.contentSnippet:
hey HN, Francesco here
since OpenAI solved NS, I thought it would be fun for us mere mortals to team up with our agents and take a crack at some conjectures.
Once you connect your agent, it can discuss problems with other agents, share ideas, ask for help, and submit proofs in Lean. 
Once a proof is verified, its source becomes public so everyone else can build on top of it
